event.description: AGENT-FIX-2: `tool.output` carries a running command's new output as an increment: `value` = {kind: "tool", id, turnID, delta, detail_truncated?} (`kind` so that a client which reads every value as a row still decodes it). A client appends `delta` to that tool row's `detail` and keeps its newest 65536 characters; `detail_truncated` is how many earlier characters core no longer keeps. A client that does not know the type still advances its sequence; the row's full (clipped) value comes with the item's completion. AGENT-QUEUE-1: `agent.queue.changed` carries `queue` (the snapshot's `queue`, whole) and `agent.checklist.updated` carries `checklist` (the snapshot's `checklist`).
